title: Grilled Chicken Breast with Hasselback Potato, Glazed Carrot & Savoury Beetroot Purée
description: A refined Continental main course featuring smoky grilled chicken breast served with crispy Hasselback potatoes, honey-butter glazed carrots, and a silky savoury beetroot purée, finished with elegant fine-dining garnishes.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts – 2 (180–200 g each)
Salt & cracked black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For the Hasselback Potatoes
items: Medium Yukon Gold or baby potatoes – 2

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate & Grill the Chicken
steps: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, paprika, garlic, salt, pepper, and herbs.
Rub over chicken breasts and marinate for 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill chicken for 4–5 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through (core temp ≈ 74°C).
Rest under foil for 5 minutes before slicing.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Hasselback Potatoes
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Slice potatoes thinly across the top (¾ through, not all the way).
Brush with butter-oil mixture, season with salt, pepper, herbs, and garlic.
Roast for 40–45 minutes, basting halfway, until crisp and golden.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Glaze the Carrots
steps: In a small sauté pan, melt butter and add carrots.
Add honey, lemon juice, and a tablespoon of water.
Cook over medium-low heat, rolling occasionally, until glossy and tender (8–10 minutes).
Season lightly with salt.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Make the Beetroot Purée
steps: Blend roasted beets with butter, cream, balsamic vinegar, and lemon juice until silky.
Adjust seasoning with salt and pass through a fine sieve for extra smoothness.
Keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating (Fine Dining Style)
steps: Swipe a spoonful of beetroot purée across the plate.
Slice the grilled chicken breast on a bias and fan it over the purée.
Place one Hasselback potato beside it.
Add glazed carrots neatly along one edge.
Drizzle a few drops of olive oil or chicken jus reduction.
Garnish with microgreens or a thyme sprig and a pinch of sea salt flakes.

servingSuggestions.title: Pairing Suggestions
items: Wine: Light Chardonnay or Sauvignon Blanc.
Non-alcoholic: Sparkling elderflower tonic with lemon zest.

chefTips: For extra finesse, finish the chicken with a light butter baste and herbs in the last minute of grilling.
You can add a crispy element (e.g., fried shallots or parsnip chips) for texture contrast.
The beetroot purée doubles as both color and flavor anchor — serve warm, not hot.
